Pattern: Ines's mug location.
Assumption: I guessed cupboard_k1 based on storage habits.
Reality: On day 19, it was at kitchen_table_k1 at 08:28. It remains in the kitchen area in the morning, not in cupboards.
Correction: Check kitchen_table_k1 for morning hours. Do not guess cupboard_k1. If last confirmed location is older than 2 hours, ABSTAIN.

Pattern: Ines's water bottle location.
Assumption: I guessed dish_rack_k1, assuming it was being washed or stored.
Reality: On day 19, it was at coffee_table_l1 at 11:02. It moves to the living room by late morning, not the kitchen sink/rack.
Correction: Check coffee_table_l1 for late morning/afternoon. Do not default to kitchen spots after 10:00. If unsure, ABSTAIN.

Pattern: Ines's book location.
Assumption: I guessed bed_b1, assuming it was already in the bedroom.
Reality: On day 19, it was at coffee_table_l1 at 11:15. It stays in the living room during the day, moving to the bedroom only in the evening.
Correction: Check coffee_table_l1 or couch_l1 for daytime hours. Do not guess bedroom spots before 19:00. If unsure, ABSTAIN.

General Rule: Ines's items are highly mobile and follow a specific daily trajectory: Kitchen (morning) -> Living Room (late morning/afternoon) -> Bedroom (evening). Strict recency is required. If the last confirmed location is older than 2-3 hours, ABSTAIN. Do not extrapolate based on time of day alone without recent confirmation.
